items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: And we did some things for them after we had added J.D. King, the tenor player.

ctx.x: Right. And we did some things for them after we had added J.D. King, the tenor player. Some of those things I wish I could take back, because we used to do some real show business type stuff on the stage, but it didn't come off too well on the record! [LAUGHS]
